If permissions are not working:
• Go to Settings > Apps > HaramBlur > Permissions
• Enable the required permissions
• Restart the app

Enhanced blocking not working?
• Check that permissions are granted
• Ensure accessibility service is enabled
• Try restarting the device

Usage Stats permission allows HaramBlur to:

• Detect when blocked apps are launched
• Apply blocking immediately
• Provide faster response times
• Monitor app usage patterns

This permission is optional and only enhances blocking speed.

Device Admin permission allows HaramBlur to:

• Force-close blocked applications
• Provide stronger enforcement
• Prevent apps from bypassing blocking
• Offer more reliable blocking

This permission is completely optional - the app works without it.

• All permissions are optional

• All processing happens locally on your device
• You can revoke permissions anytime
